demand_recovery.basis: Nearest retained WorldPop pixel at each actual native grid cell centre, existing log/smooth/normalise and OSM anchor blend; relative routing/station index only. Unsupported cells receive no population contribution, not an assertion of no residents.

population_source.attribution: WorldPop, University of Southampton, 2020; CC BY 4.0
population_source.nodata: Source nodata/out-of-extent and invalid values excluded and reported; never filled with people.
population_source.pixel_selection: Native pixel centres inside the city bbox; no resampling.

restored_route_shapes.basis: Retained source corridor, bounded contour fillets and water/protected/terrain constraints; no forced radial chord
